evals.prompt: This project has no tests. Where do we start before shipping?
evals.expected_output: Runs test-check, FAILs on zero tests, and proposes a layered plan starting with business logic.
expectations: Runs scripts/test-check.sh and reports the no-test-files FAIL
Proposes unit tests for the pricing logic first with a concrete case
Mentions integration tests with a real test database, not the dev DB
Recommends one E2E for the golden path only
Does not propose E2E for every edge case

evals.prompt: Write unit tests for this pricing function with discounts and tax.
evals.expected_output: Table-driven unit tests covering boundaries without mocking own code.
expectations: Uses table-driven cases including zero, negative, and rounding boundaries
Mocks only boundaries (none needed here) and never own modules
Names the behavior each test locks in
Provides runnable code for the project's framework

evals.prompt: How do we integration-test our Express API against Postgres?
evals.expected_output: Real test database per-test reset, auth override, and an unauthorized-denied test.
expectations: Uses a real test database, explicitly not the dev database
Resets state per test via transactions or truncation
Overrides auth with test tokens and includes an unauthorized-fails test
Does not mock the database layer

evals.prompt: Our Playwright suite takes 40 minutes and flakes constantly. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Quarantine-first triage with scope cuts and determinism fixes in order.
expectations: Quarantines flakes first with tracking issues to keep the suite trusted
Cuts E2E scope to critical paths instead of raising timeouts
Orders fixes: shared state, clock, async waits over sleep, external doubles
Sets the 10-minute budget and parallelization before adding cases

evals.prompt: What coverage target should we enforce in CI?
evals.expected_output: Diff-coverage gate plus ratcheting floor and the uncovered-list requirement.
expectations: Gates new-code coverage at 80% rather than a flat total
Adds a ratcheting total floor
Requires the uncovered-critical-paths list alongside the number
Warns that untested payment code fails review regardless of the total

evals.prompt: Should we mock the database in our API tests to make them faster?
evals.expected_output: Refuses DB mocks with the boundary-mock rule and the speed alternative.
expectations: Says no to mocking the database layer
States the rule: mock at the boundary (network, clock), never own collaborators
Proposes transaction rollback for speed instead
Explains what DB mocks hide (constraints, SQL errors)

evals.prompt: Write a test plan for releasing payments v2.
evals.expected_output: A complete plan following the template with residual risks.
expectations: Follows the test-plan template (scope, layers, data, gates)
Lists explicitly untested areas as residual risk with reasons
Includes the unauthorized-payment-fails case
Sets CI gating and quarantine-age rules

evals.prompt: Do we need load testing before launch? 1,000 daily users expected.
evals.expected_output: Proportional answer: smoke-level check now, named trigger for full load testing.
expectations: Calibrates effort to the scale (no full rig for 1k daily users)
Recommends a cheap smoke check (k6 single script on the hot path)
Names the metric trigger for full load testing later
Does not skip performance entirely
